business.title: Create a virtual employee
business.goal: Ask for a new agent by describing it and its functions in plain words.

steps.title: Open the agents list
steps.description: The admin opens the first screen with the agents and drafts and chooses to create a new virtual employee.

steps.title: Describe the new agent
steps.description: The admin writes a prompt describing the new agent and its functions, and the request goes to the cm, which prepares a draft or refuses it.

steps.title: Follow the draft situation
steps.description: The admin sees the draft on the list as preparing, ready, or refused with the reason.

outcome.statement: A draft request for the new virtual employee is with the cm and visible on the agents list.
evidence: The draft card appears on the first screen as preparing
When refused, the card shows the reason given by the cm

business.title: Review and activate a draft
business.goal: Check a ready draft, adjust its tools, simulate it and put it to work or discard it.

steps.title: Open the ready draft
steps.description: The admin opens the draft the cm reported as ready, whose suggested tools are already on for it.

steps.title: Review the draft
steps.description: The admin reads what the agent is, who it talks to and its proposed behavior.

steps.title: Adjust its tools
steps.description: The admin turns tools on or off in the module / subject / action tree; these choices are never overridden by the automatic choice.

steps.title: Simulate the draft
steps.description: The admin checks what the agent can do for a chosen role and what it understands from a sample sentence.

steps.title: Activate or discard
steps.description: The admin decides whether the draft becomes an active agent or is discarded.

steps.title: Activate the agent
steps.description: The cm is asked to activate the draft as a working agent.

steps.title: Discard the draft
steps.description: The cm is asked to discard the draft.

outcome.statement: The draft is either an active agent with the reviewed tools or discarded.
evidence: An activated agent shows on the list as on, with its responsible person
A discarded draft no longer shows as ready

business.title: Change an agent's behavior
business.goal: Tell an agent in plain words how it should behave differently, or undo a past change.

steps.title: Find the agent
steps.description: The admin opens the agent from the list or from the agent already in hand.

steps.title: Read current behavior
steps.description: The admin reads the current behavior in plain language and the history of changes with who, when and a summary.

steps.title: Say what to change
steps.description: The admin writes what should change in the box and the cm updates the behavior.

steps.title: Undo a change
steps.description: When needed, the admin undoes a change from the history through the cm.

outcome.statement: The agent behaves as the admin asked, and the change is in its history.
evidence: The behavior text shows the new behavior
The history lists the change with who, when and a one-line summary

business.title: Adjust an agent's tools
business.goal: Decide which actions an agent may use.

steps.title: Find the agent
steps.description: The admin opens the agent and its tools scenario.

steps.title: Browse the tools tree
steps.description: The admin reads the tree of modules, subjects and actions with readable names and descriptions, removed tools marked as such.

steps.title: Turn tools on or off
steps.description: The admin checks or unchecks actions for this agent, and the choice is kept as the admin's own.

outcome.statement: The agent has exactly the tools the admin chose.
evidence: The checkboxes show the admin's choices
Later automatic choices do not change them

business.title: Configure an agent
business.goal: Set how people call the agent, whether it is on and who is responsible for it.

steps.title: Find the agent
steps.description: The admin opens the agent and its configuration scenario.

steps.title: Read the configuration
steps.description: The admin sees the @name, whether it is on, the responsible person and the limits as the cm lists them.

steps.title: Save the changes
steps.description: The admin changes the @name, on or off and the responsible person through the cm, which refuses a name already used by another active agent and the screen says so.

outcome.statement: The agent's configuration is updated in the cm, or the admin knows why the name was refused.
evidence: The configuration shows the new @name, state and responsible person
A refused name shows a clear message

business.title: Simulate an agent by role
business.goal: See what an agent can do for a person or role and how it reads a sentence.

steps.title: Find the agent
steps.description: The admin opens the agent and its simulation scenario.

steps.title: See what it can
steps.description: For a chosen person or role, the admin sees which tools can or cannot be used and why.

steps.title: See what it understands
steps.description: For a sentence, the admin sees whether it asks for an action, which path of the tree and which actions.

outcome.statement: The admin knows what the agent would do for that role and sentence.
evidence: The list of usable and blocked tools with reasons is shown
The understood path and actions are shown for the sentence

business.title: Restrict a person's tools
business.goal: Mark the tools a person may not use through any agent.

steps.title: Choose the person
steps.description: The admin picks the person from the organization users.

steps.title: Review current restrictions
steps.description: The admin sees the tool checklist with the tools already blocked for this person.

steps.title: Mark blocked tools
steps.description: The admin checks or unchecks the tools this person may not use through any agent.

outcome.statement: No agent offers the blocked tools when this person calls it.
evidence: The checklist shows the blocked tools for the person
A simulation for the person shows those tools as not usable

business.title: See agents and their activity
business.goal: Know which agents exist, what they are for and what they did.

steps.title: Browse the agents
steps.description: The member sees the agent cards with name, who it talks to, whether it is on and who is responsible.

steps.title: Read the overview
steps.description: The member reads what the agent is, who it talks to and on whose behalf it acts.

steps.title: See what it did
steps.description: The member reads the executions newest first: when, how long, cost, actions and results, whether a person took over, and the link to the conversation.

outcome.statement: The member understands what the agent is and what it has been doing.
evidence: The overview is shown read only
The activity list shows the executions newest first

business.title: Simulate an agent as myself
business.goal: Check what an agent can do for me and how it reads my request.

steps.title: Find the agent
steps.description: The member opens the agent and its simulation scenario.

steps.title: See what it can for me
steps.description: The member sees which tools the agent can or cannot use for them and why.

steps.title: Test a sentence
steps.description: The member types a sentence and sees whether it asks for an action, which path and which actions.

outcome.statement: The member knows what the agent would do for them.
evidence: The usable and blocked tools for the member are shown with reasons
The understood actions for the sentence are shown

business.title: Change my conduct with an agent
business.goal: Adjust how an agent that acts on my behalf behaves for me.

steps.title: Find my agent
steps.description: The member opens an agent that acts on their behalf.

steps.title: Read my conduct
steps.description: The member reads how the agent currently behaves for them and the history of their changes.

steps.title: Say what to change
steps.description: The member writes what should change for them and the cm updates only their own conduct.

outcome.statement: The agent behaves as the member asked when acting on their behalf, without affecting others.
evidence: The member's conduct shows the change
The history lists the change with when and a one-line summary
